summary:
OPPY: The Red Journey is a browser-based 2D survival and science-exploration game inspired by NASA’s Opportunity (MER-B) Mars rover. Players drive Opportunity across Mars from Sol 1 in Eagle Crater to Sol 5,111 in Perseverance Valley—scanning ancient water clues, recharging in sunlight, deploying solar-panel shields against dust storms, escaping Purgatory Dune, and making five real JPL engineering decisions.

Our project transforms 14+ years of real Mars Exploration Rover telemetry, geology, and survival challenges into an accessible, story-driven experience for students and the public. By combining interactive gameplay with an unlockable Field Log containing verified NASA archives, it inspires curiosity about planetary science without requiring any downloads.
details:
How It Works:

Players control Opportunity across five historical Martian regions (Eagle Crater, Endurance Crater, Victoria Crater, Endeavour Crater, and Perseverance Valley). To survive 5,111 Martian sols, players must:

- Scan hematite "blueberries," sulfates, and clay minerals using Oppy’s RAT rock drill and spectrometer to collect water clues and refill energy.

- Deploy a protective solar-panel shield (Space / Shield button) and Dust Pulse to survive dust tornadoes and clear panel dust.

- Recharge inside fading sunny spots, escape Purgatory Dune, dodge seismic ground collapses, and use cleaning winds for speed boosts.

- Solve 5 real JPL engineering dilemmas (Sol 48 RAT drilling, Endurance descent, Sol 433 jammed wheel backwards driving, Sol 2811 Greeley Haven winter tilt, and Sol 4155 RAM-only mode).

- Unlock 4 real NASA archive photos with source links inside the in-game Field Log, while tracking live Tau atmospheric opacity (0.6 to 10.8) and solar power (645 to 22 Wh).

Tools & Technology:

- HTML5, CSS3, and Vanilla JavaScript (HTML5 2D Canvas)

- Web Audio API for procedural music tracks, retro character voice blips, and sound effects

- Responsive touch joystick + desktop keyboard controls, hosted on Netlify

Creativity & Impact:

Instead of reading static mission timelines, players emotionally experience Opportunity’s journey—from an expected 90-sol mission to a 45.16 km Mars marathon and the final dust storm.

Super Intelligence (SI) Disclosure:

- Images: Game illustrations and comic panels were generated using AI tools and display a visible "AI-Generated Art" watermark inside the application.

- Code & Text: AI assistance was used to help write/refine game code, UI text, and presentation content.

- Audio: Procedural Web Audio API synthesis is generated in code; the finale music track (final_muzik.mp3) should also be noted as AI-generated/external audio depending on its source.
